segments.text: Cinema is one of the newest of all the arts born at the start of the 20th century
In just over a hundred years film has become the center of all entertainment
The power of cinema lies in recreating a story before our eyes
A dramatic scene shakes the heart of the audience
And a comedy creates laughter
A great film presents social issues in a way
That fascinates and makes the viewer think
By retelling historical events from a creative angle
It delivers emotional truths that a textbook cannot
Film critics evaluate a work from many sides
Awards such as the Academy Awards have served
To make the quality of films known to the world
Watching a film is not mere amusement
In a dark theater, we relive the life of another
What impresses us is not only the beauty of the images
It is because the choices and conflicts of the characters
Throw questions at our own way of living
In the digital age, the way films are made
And watched has changed
But the essence to move the human heart through story
Has not changed, one bits in cinema
Was born with such enthusiasm
A century ago
You
